description: We are a team of five students studying at the Faculty of Computer and Data Science, Alexandria University. We are interested in Machine Learning, Data Analysis, Backend Development, and Data Science. We are currently looking for someone with experience in Game Development to join our team and contribute their skills to our project.
summary:
Khepri Space Mission is an educational space exploration and mission simulation game designed for children aged 8–14. Through the journey of Khepri, a young Egyptian boy dreaming of exploring space, players design and manage missions, explore the Moon and Mars, operate spacecraft systems, collect scientific samples, and make engineering decisions while balancing limited resources.

The project addresses the challenge by transforming complex space engineering concepts into accessible, interactive experiences where children learn through experimentation, exploration, and problem-solving. Beyond its technical and educational purpose, Khepri Space Mission carries a deeper mission: inspiring a new generation of Egyptian children to imagine themselves as astronauts, scientists, and space engineers, careers that may feel distant or unimaginable to many of them today.

The name Khepri comes from ancient Egyptian mythology, where Khepri symbolizes the rising sun, creation, and rebirth. It represents our vision of a new sunrise for science in Egypt: reviving curiosity, creating new ambitions, and giving children the confidence to dream of reaching beyond Earth. We want the next generation to grow up believing that space exploration is not just something they watch others achieve, but something they can be part of.
details:
Every great journey begins with a dream, and every generation deserves the chance to reach beyond what it believes is possible.

For Egyptian children, the stars have always been part of our story. Thousands of years ago, ancient Egyptians looked to the heavens, studied the stars, and used their knowledge to understand the world around them. Today, we dream of inspiring a new generation to take that curiosity even further. We want Egyptian children to grow up believing that they can become the astronauts, scientists, and engineers who shape humanity's future in space. We want to turn distant dreams into possibilities and imagination into ambition.

This vision inspired Khepri Space Mission, an educational space-exploration game that connects Egypt's remarkable scientific heritage with the future of space exploration. Its name, Khepri, is inspired by ancient Egyptian mythology, where it symbolizes the rising sun, creation, and renewal. It represents our hope for a new dawn for Egyptian science, driven by the curiosity and dreams of the next generation.

What does the project do, and how does it work?

Khepri Space Mission is designed for children aged 8–14. Players follow Khepri, a young Egyptian boy whose curiosity and dream of exploring space take him on a journey from ancient Egyptian astronomy to modern space exploration. Through storytelling, interactive environments, educational challenges, and mission-based activities, players discover scientific concepts and experience aspects of what it takes to explore space. The game introduces players to lunar science, spacecraft systems, scientific investigation, and the decisions involved in planning and carrying out a space mission.

What benefits does it have?

The game makes complex scientific and engineering concepts more approachable through interactive learning rather than relying only on traditional explanations. It encourages curiosity, critical thinking, creativity, problem-solving, and an interest in STEM fields. By combining education with entertainment, it gives children an opportunity to explore scientific ideas in an environment where learning feels like an adventure.

What is the intended impact?

Our greatest ambition is to change how Egyptian children imagine their futures. We want a child playing Khepri Space Mission to finish the experience believing that becoming an astronaut, building a spacecraft, or contributing to a scientific discovery is something they can aspire to achieve. We hope to make space exploration feel closer, more accessible, and more inclusive, inspiring children to pursue the knowledge and skills that could one day take them beyond Earth.

What tools did we use?

The game is developed using the Godot game engine, with GDScript for gameplay programming. GitHub Copilot was used as an AI-assisted coding tool to support programming, code refinement, and troubleshooting. AI-assisted suggestions were reviewed and adapted by the development team during implementation.

How is the project creative?

Khepri Space Mission combines Egyptian cultural identity, storytelling, astronomy, and interactive game-based education into one experience. Rather than presenting space science as a collection of facts, it places children inside a journey where they can discover, explore, and learn. Its central creative idea is to connect two moments in history: the ancient Egyptians who observed the heavens and the next generation that may help humanity explore them.

What factors did the team consider?

We considered the intended age group, accessibility, educational value, scientific accuracy, cultural relevance, and the overall player experience. The game is designed to make scientific ideas understandable for children aged 8–14 without losing the excitement of exploration. We also considered how to balance entertainment and education, present space-related challenges in an engaging way, and make the experience welcoming to children with different levels of scientific knowledge.

Ultimately, Khepri Space Mission is about more than exploring space. It is about opening a new path for Egyptian children's dreams, giving their imagination room to grow, and reminding them that the future of space exploration can include them, too.
